text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Macedonian parliament ratifies agreement on trade cooperation with Yugoslavia with barely a quorum. In the few discussions the deputies stressed the need of signing similar agreements with all neighbouring countries.

- Prilep Tobacco Industry, Macedonia Tabak and the Philip Morris International signed on Wednesday in Prilep an agreement on licence production, distribution and sale of Bond and Partner cigarettes. Soon the list to be extended to LM, Marlboro and Chesterfield.
- All parties to submit their candidate lists for the November 17 local elections by Thursday midnight. Election campaign starts officially on Friday.

- Association of Aegean Macedonians expressed their dissatisfaction with the constant discrimination of ethnic Macedonians in Greeece and asked the government to react during a meeting with Foreign Minister Ljubomir Frckovski.
- U.S. military medical experts in Macedonia today to help the medical team investigating causes of mass poisoning of Albanian children in the Tetovo region.
- Albanian parents to be on duty in Tetovo schools to prevent future poisonings of Albanian children. This was proposed by PDP deputies at Wednesday's session of the Tetovo assembly.
- Macedonian opposition warns that there will be manipulations at local elections.
